description.value:
You may cast Magic Circle as a Ritual once per day. Your influence over your Vassals deepens. You can summon your Vassal into a Magic Circle you have cast and when you do so, it gains the ability to cast the corresponding spells as shown on the Spellbinding table without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. When it does so, the Vassal reduces its maximum Hit Points by 5 plus 5 times the level of the spell. The Vassal cannot cast a spell that is of a higher level than your highest level spell slot.

VassalSpells
AllAugury, Clairvoyance, Divination, Dream
AberrationHallucinatory Terrain
DragonCircle of Power
FiendTeleportation Circle
UndeadSpeak with Dead
